comparison.objective: Remove a drawer by pressing two opposite-sense release levers while pulling; candidate removes a terminal by depressing two locking tangs while pulling its wire.
comparison.physical_skill: Simultaneous dual-lever actuation and large drawer pull versus precision dual-blade insertion around a recessed contact, sustained tang depression, optional forward unload, and opposite-side wire pull.
comparison.success_condition: Requires both levers actuated and the drawer fully removed, set down, released, and still; candidate additionally requires correct-contact selectivity, retained neighbors, intact crimp/housing, and tool-mediated tang release. Candidate force/damage limits are missing.
comparison.reason: This is the closest functional analogue, but the candidate meaningfully tests recessed selective tool insertion and contact-level damage avoidance absent from drawer removal.
